ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Dominantly low-intensity (black) pixel distribution with high-intensity (white) localized pixels. Estimated macro-level ratio of high-to-low intensity pixels is approximately 1:12.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: The visible surface is primarily a uniform low-intensity black field. High-contrast white geometric units are restricted to small circular ring-shaped features (5-20 pixel diameters) scattered across both lobes, with no large-scale contiguous white pigmentation blobs.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: V-shaped central depression with an acute convergence angle; depth and precise pixel vertex are partially obscured by water spray and low-angle perspective.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous irregular serration along the trailing edge boundary; contains high-frequency peaks and valleys with pixel-amplitudes between 3 and 12 pixels, most pronounced on the distal portion of the right lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Bilateral convex trajectory from the median notch to distal tips; the left lobe displays a steeper upward sweep relative to the horizontal plane due to the animal's pitch.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Spatially discrete clusters of circular white rings. Notable constellation on the left lobe mid-section and multiple scattered rings across the central and outer planes of the right lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Several faint, unaligned white linear pixel disruptions (scratches) are visible, particularly on the medial surface of the right lobe with vertical and diagonal orientations.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Accumulation of orange and brown high-relief textural clusters (biological growth) concentrated along the distal tips and proximal trailing edge boundaries.
